उन्निद्र a. [उद्गता निद्रा यस्य]
1
Sleepless, awake, without one wink of
sleep; तामुन्निद्रामवनिशयनां
सौधवातायनस्थः

To lead upwards,
bring up.
--2 To raise, erect, lift
up (A.); दंडमुन्नयते Sk.; स्वदंष्ट्रोन्नीतधरो
वराहः Bhāg.
--3 To bring out of, free
from, help, rescue, redeem; रसाया
लीलयोन्नीतां उर्वीं Bhāg.
--4 To draw up
(as water).
--5 To stroke;
straighten out.
--6 To lead out or
aside, lead away; एकांतमुन्नीय Mb.
--7 To press out, extract.
--8 To
infer, ascertain, guess,
conjecture; कथमपि स इत्युन्नेतव्यस्तथापि दृशोः
प्रियः

;
प्रकृतिप्रत्ययाद्यर्थैः संकीर्णे लिंगमुन्नयेत्
Ak.
--9 To fill completely.
--10 To
lead off (in singing).

ऊनित p. p. Lessened by
subtraction, less, fewer &c.
